slug: 2024-04-23 The Gambia Social Registry - A Success Story in Systems Building

facts.fact: The World Bank blog says the Gambia Social Registry (GamSR), covering 203,022 households in 40 of 43 districts, underpinned the Nafa Quick COVID-19 response (78,422 households) and the Nafa cash-transfer programme (16,966 households), and is also used by the National Disaster Management Agency, the ROOTS project and the World Food Programme; no event date is given, so the publication date is used.

note: No statement of a link to the national ID, a payment provider or another sector's system; only shared use of the registry.
